correctness.rationale: For each x, all two-variable atomic diagrams reduce to eight tests. The four-point exceptional set, its doubling fibre of size |G[2]|, and generic involution/non-involution witnesses give exact universal pointed profiles. Their presence is determined for every finite abelian 2-group by cyclic-factor multiplicity thresholds; the exhaustive fifteen-case table and distinct profiles follow. The sharp minimal representative order 128 follows from the least possible structure with two factors of order at least eight and one at least sixteen. Separately implemented full-language brute-force checks on actual representative groups and a second algebraic-mask checker corroborate all finite boundary claims. No finite test is used to prove the unbounded parameters.
